description: Phase 14.3 readiness gate — determines next phase based on product documentation convergence results

ready_for_feature_build.reason: Product docs not fully readable. Requirements gaps identified for all three apps. UMH integration boundaries undefined.

ready_for_infrastructure_implementation.reason: Product docs convergence incomplete. Feature scope unknown. Infrastructure decisions depend on product scope.

ready_for_github_windows_alignment.reason: Source reality is known. GitHub/Beast are code source truth. Alignment can proceed independently of product docs.

ready_for_product_docs_convergence.reason: Document inventory completed from cache. Full content ingestion blocked by API access. Classification and end-state design map produced at summary level.

ready_for_eos_convergence_planning.reason: EntrepreneurOS Google Doc status unclear (may be contaminated working doc). Full PRD content needed. UMH integration boundary not defined.

ready_for_creatoros_convergence_planning.reason: CreatorOS PRD v2.90 exists but content not readable. Clerk migration plan required.

ready_for_lyfeos_convergence_planning.reason: LyfeOS Google Doc content not readable. Game of Lyfe mechanics unspecified. Clerk migration plan required.

remaining_blockers: Google Docs API access — content not readable from VPS CLI context
Product requirements gaps for all three apps
UMH integration boundaries not defined for any app
EntrepreneurOS doc may not be clean PRD
CreatorOS PRD v2.90 full content not accessible
LyfeOS product spec full content not accessible
Game of Lyfe mechanics not specified
Clerk migration plans not created for CreatorOS and LyfeOS

recommended_next_phase.rationale: Full content access is the single highest-value unblock. The cached summaries confirm valuable PRDs exist (especially CreatorOS v2.90). Resolving API access enables complete content ingestion, which unblocks requirements gap closure.
recommended_next_phase.alternative_1_rationale: Promote what we have (inventory, classification, end-state map at summary level) as production truth, noting the access blocker
recommended_next_phase.alternative_2: Phase 14.4 — EOS GitHub/Windows Alignment + Product Design Diff
recommended_next_phase.alternative_2_rationale: GitHub/Windows alignment is ready regardless of docs access. Can proceed in parallel.

verdict: PARTIAL — Phase 14.3 completed at metadata level. Full content convergence requires Google Docs API access resolution.
